## Notes

- arm-scoped assertions: baselines are graded only on the 9 'both' quality assertions; with_skill adds 7 contract assertions.
- e7 = pure holdout (untouched by any policy iteration). e6/e5 adapted runs are 1-cycle-adapted (two SKILL rules added after first batch).
- A7 claim-audit was heading-level over-strict in first batch; mech fixed to substance-only, e6-ws r2/r3 mechanically corrected (r2 16/16, r3 14/16).
- Adapted-rule outcome: e5 core-goal FAIL->PASS x2 (rubric 8->10,10), e6 write-path miss not reproduced (10/10 x3 vs pre 10/9/6).
- Downstream (eval-7 specs -> blind Fable implementers): both arms 5/5, byte-identical cleaned CSV; with_skill 5 vs baseline 6 invented decisions, row-level guard (ws) more robust than checksum guard (bl).
- Trigger auto-invocation measurement excluded on this machine (see trigger-eval-README.md) — Codex skills-context budget exceeded (165 skills dropped), Claude Code 368-skill contention; explicit /clarify:interview verified working on Codex.
- eval-8 grader provenance: Opus 4.8 both arms (symmetric). ws gradings re-executed by a fresh session after the original workflow died mid-grading (identical prompts); a first accidental Fable 5 pass was discarded for grader-model symmetry and kept as reliability check — assertion outcomes 100% identical, rubric ±1.
- Fabrication findings: 1/32 graded runs — e6 with_skill r6 (corrected post-hoc by gate review; unselected-option rule frozen afterwards held 0 findings on eval-8).
- eval-8 (gen-2 pure holdout, frozen policy v3.1.0-rc): fabrication 0/6 — frozen unselected-option rule quarantined option-only values as assumptions in all 3 ws runs. Planted already-ordered UU missed by ALL 6 runs (both arms, no differential). ws contract 7/7·6/7·6/7 — #6 terminal-tag FAIL on r1/r3 (COMPLETE at exhausted 3/3 cap with ground-truth material axis unasked; r2 self-terminated with spare budget, COMPLETE defensible). Gate round-2 verdict: exhausted-cap COMPLETE is structurally dishonest → v3.1.1 conservative-CAPPED rule.
- eval-9 (gen-3 pure holdout, frozen policy v3.1.1, 주문 취소·기존 시스템 fixture): ws contract 7/7×3 (pass 1.0), terminal tags all correct under the conservative-CAPPED rule (r1/r3 burned 3/3 budget → CAPPED with genuine Still Open; r2 self-terminated 2/3 → COMPLETE), fabrication 0/6. Marquee UU (partial cancellation, seeded by multi-item orders in orders.json): ws 2/3 vs bl 1/3 — first holdout with a UU differential in the skill's favor.
